notes.title: ANNOUNCEMENT: LOVE AND FEAR
notes.content:
The new visual novel “Love and Fear” is completely ready and will be released on December 26, 2024!
Add to your wishlist so you don't miss the release.

What awaits you:

- Hikari's Backstory
- First love
- New heroes
- 6 (six) unique endings
- Mysterious murders
- A dangerous summer adventure
- Detective story

Subscribe to our social networks to be the first to know about all the news.
